component: Real Windows alias and invalid-name observations retain required portable state snapshot/restore coverage
source_changes: Only the two native-filename fixture functions change (two case-alias parametrizations and one invalid-name case), plus a small actual-restore mkdir observer and imports.
Exclusive native creation must expose a real same-file alias or the requested separate spellings. The alias branch requires equal native device/inode identity and exact canonical physical inventory.

The canonical real files are snapshotted through current snapshot_state and compared by exact manifest and bytes. The requested colliding names, with real byte sizes and hashes, then pass into actual restore_state and must be rejected before any destination mkdir.

The invalid '?' fixture attempts actual creation. Only an observed Windows EINVAL or WinError123 permits a real ordinary-file snapshot followed by malformed-manifest restore refusal; unexpected failures stay failures.
The actual POSIX collision and invalid-name snapshot refusals remain. Source and stage bytes remain exact, and seven other test bodies and every parametrization remain unchanged.
evidence_boundary: The existing exact b346 fixture has explicit platform skips that conflict with the strict whole27 gate. Root reported actual Windows24 passed/3 skipped and Linux27 passed. This successor has not executed and transfers no runtime verdict.
